meta_description: FSSAI notifies advisory for selling or marketing of fruit juices with non standardized ingredients - Stay informed about the FSSAI advisory on selling and marketing juices with non-standardized ingredients. Learn the importance of accurate labeling and avoiding false advertisements to ensure compliance with food safety regulations in India
body_html: On July 31, 2024, the FSSAI issued an advisory on the sale and marketing of fruit juices containing non-standardized ingredients. Regulated FBOs are required to strictly comply with these regulations, as the use of non-standardized ingredients is prohibited. This update outlines the necessary steps FBOs must take to ensure compliance.
